notes: New noise-suppression level, Studio: also removes music, other people talking and fans, and leaves your voice as it is. Others hear you about 50 ms later than with Enhanced, and it uses more of your PC's processor; Relay steps down by itself if the PC cannot keep up. Enhanced stays the default and is unchanged. Measured on the audio bench with a recorded voice; not yet tried in a live call. Includes a new client, schema-30 server and iroh helper; no server code changed.
